title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 18: Scars Mean We Survived

scenes.say: A radio station. Ali hosts a show on mental health for Black vets.
scenes.visual: a radio studio microphone with an on-air light glowing, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: We ain't crazy. We're scarred. And scars mean we survived.
scenes.visual: a man speaking into a studio microphone, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Phones ring in. Thank you, man. I needed this.
scenes.visual: phone lines lighting up on a studio board, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: School field. Ali coaches flag football. Laughs. Shouts. Celebrates.
scenes.visual: kids playing flag football on a school field, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Joy found me when I stopped running from it.
scenes.visual: a coach celebrating with kids, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A bookstore. A long line. Ali signs copies of Hoodlum Soldier.
scenes.visual: a long line of readers at a bookstore signing table, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: One teen holds the book tight. This saved me, for real.
scenes.visual: a teenager holding a book to his chest, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a signed book on a table, warm light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Nineteen. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a bookstore window at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 18 of 25: Scars Mean We Survived. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
